sourceDescriptionLines: Management Exception Dashboard is a priority screen for unusual business conditions that need management attention.
It separates Critical, Watch and Information-level signals using transparent live-data report rules.
Inventory-health exceptions, pending transfers and other trained signals are surfaced so management can work by priority instead of scanning every transaction.
The report explains the selected exception scope and the business meaning of each status.

sourceDescriptionLines: Brand Wise Purchase connects buying value and quantity with supplier/product exposure, sales movement and current stock wherever the trained data supports those links.

sourceDescriptionLines: AI Store Sales Forecast explains a transparent forecast or actual-vs-prediction question using historical business data and deterministic calculations.

The report starts with Forecast Sales, Forecast Qty, Forecast Growth %, Confidence % and adds Forecast Amount/Qty, Actual Amount/Qty, Accuracy, Confidence, Variance, Growth and planning-risk figures where available.
The selected From/To range remains the only user date range; a future horizon is displayed automatically only when the report truly calculates future demand/value.
Trend context and contribution views are added so forecast results are not judged from one total alone.
Forecast values are planning signals rather than guaranteed sales; material misses should be investigated for seasonality, availability, price/mix and unusual trading days.
The decision scorecard explains each forecast figure in plain language and the detail table keeps actual and prediction values side-by-side.
Use forecast as a planning signal, compare it with actual performance, and adjust inventory progressively.
All numeric values come from deterministic live SQL or transparent derived formulas; AI text explains the figures and does not invent them.

sourceDescriptionLines: Actual Margin vs AI Forecast explains a transparent forecast or actual-vs-prediction question using historical business data and deterministic calculations.
